findings.evidence: '.ds-card[data-variant="outlined"] { border: 1px solid var(--color-border); }'. The Card, Modal and skip-link CSS use --color-border, --radius-lg, --spacing-6, --shadow-lg and --shadow-xl. The 'Semantic tokens and state contract' block defines none of them, and nothing states how DTCG paths (spacing.scale.6, radius.lg, color.semantic.border.default) become CSS variable names.
findings.fix: Add a short naming rule under 'Semantic tokens and state contract': DTCG path segments joined with '-' (spacing.scale.6 -> --spacing-6, shadow.lg -> --shadow-lg). Also add --color-border (border.default, gray-500 passes 3:1) to both theme blocks, so every variable the examples use is defined.
